name: a drafted reply appears under a real post
looks: A single post card holds centre frame with its vote count and comment count, then a draft reply card slides up beneath it already written, with one phrase in the accent colour calling out the specific hook.
build: glass-ui-flow: the post card is a static DOM panel; the draft reply slides up and fades in on power3.out, its accent phrase getting a short colour-in animation a beat after the card settles.
sound: A soft whoosh as the reply card slides up, a light tick on the accent phrase.
prompt: Hold a single real-looking post card in frame, then slide a draft reply up beneath it, already written, with one short phrase highlighted in the accent colour as the specific, non-generic hook. Use it to show the product doing the hard writing step instantly.
